premises.text: The conditions today are favorable for personal robotics to become common in homes
premises.evidence_span: the conditions today, economical and technological, are very similar to different revolutions that moved us from this computer's large, expensive, difficult to use, to this computer's personal and in every home

premises.text: Advances in miniaturization and smartphone and cloud robotics make robots more affordable and upgradable
premises.evidence_span: miniaturization and advances in rapid manufacturing and commercialization and manufacturing, reduction of costs of components, but mostly smartphone robotics and cloud robotics

premises.text: Targeted robots can perform limited tasks effectively and are more affordable
premises.evidence_span: we're going to have a set of robots that are much more targeted at limited set of tasks that can slowly get into the house because they're more affordable

premises.text: The Shimmy robot uses smartphone and cloud technology for enhanced functionality
premises.evidence_span: Shimmy is a robotic speaker dog that doesn't just play the music for you. It actually listens to it and enjoys it as much as you do

premises.text: The robot can perform real-time tasks using cloud data and smartphone capabilities
premises.evidence_span: it's taking information from the cloud that has the beats, the segments, where the chorus starts, where the verse starts, what genre of the song is

premises.text: The robot can track faces and adjust its position for optimal sound
premises.evidence_span: using the camera to track my faces, always pointing towards me and giving me the best sound possible

premises.text: The price point of the robot is set to attract early adopters
premises.evidence_span: we're very happy that today we can announce that the robot, we're able to get it to $199

value.text: Personal robotics can become engaging, affordable, and fun-to-use in homes

notes: Demo issues and Kickstarter details excluded as traction.
